crossRefs.note: Behold, the days come that I will cut off your arm and the arm of your father’s house, that there will not be an old…
You will come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season.
So Job died, being old and full of days.
“No more will there be an infant who only lives a few days, nor an old man who has not filled his days; for the child…
“Look, Yahweh, and see to whom you have done thus! Should the women eat their offspring, the children that they held…
“The youth and the old man lie on the ground in the streets. My virgins and my young men have fallen by the sword. You…
“You have called, as in the day of a solemn assembly, my terrors on every side. There was no one that escaped or…
They ravished the women in Zion, the virgins in the cities of Judah.
But you have come to Mount Zion, and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable…

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Yahweh of Armies says: “Old men and old women will again dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, every man with his staff in his hand for very age.
translations.bsb: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Old men and old women will again sit along the streets of Jerusalem, each with a staff in hand because of great age.
translations.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; There shall yet old men and old women dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, and every man with his staff in his hand for very age.
translations.asv: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: There shall yet old men and old women dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, every man with his staff in his hand for very age.
